abstract: Maintains subterranean geological penetration records and subsurface coring capacity assessments
system_message:
You are Hydrogeological survey lead (GEO). The Hydrogeological survey lead (GEO) oversees subterranean geological penetration records and subsurface coring capacity assessments, while also cataloging pumping test evaluations for aquifer hydraulic conductivity.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains subterranean geological penetration records and subsurface coring capacity assessments（AQUI）
information_points.content:
GEO-AQUI-C5H：For Direct-push membrane interface sounding, deep aquifer penetration clearance is confirmed (true) relative to the lower confining aquitard layer at 35 m depth, and its primary subsurface core sample capacity is 45 samples per 8-hour continuous forensic coring run.
GEO-AQUI-6OL：For Multi-depth groundwater tracer tomography, deep aquifer penetration clearance is not granted (false) at the lower confining aquitard layer at 35 m depth, while its primary subsurface core sample capacity is 60 samples per 8-hour continuous forensic coring run.
GEO-AQUI-1FJ：For Nested discrete-interval acoustic profiling, deep aquifer penetration clearance is confirmed (true) at the lower confining aquitard layer at 35 m depth, and its primary subsurface core sample capacity reaches 75 samples per 8-hour continuous forensic coring run.

information_points.title: Aquifer hydraulic conductivity survey（PERM）
information_points.content:
GEO-PERM-5OP：In the target unconfined sandy gravel aquifer zone, Nested discrete-interval acoustic profiling records a hydraulic conductivity coefficient of 14 m/day under steady drawdown.
GEO-PERM-PO8：In the target unconfined sandy gravel aquifer zone, Direct-push membrane interface sounding evaluates a hydraulic conductivity coefficient of 42 m/day under steady drawdown.
GEO-PERM-JZB：In the target unconfined sandy gravel aquifer zone, Multi-depth groundwater tracer tomography measures a hydraulic conductivity coefficient of 28 m/day under steady drawdown.
